discription: A pad-like sound using a pulse wave passed through a low-pass filter with an ADSR envelope. The filter cutoff can be modulated.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=3000, rq=0.5, pulseWidth=0.2;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.5, 0.5, 0.7, 2.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var filterEnv = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 0.5),        gate: gate    );    var osc = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth);    var filterFreq = Lag.kr(cutoff * filterEnv, 0.01);    sig = LPF.ar(osc, filterFreq.clip(40, 18000), rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
